payload.title: personal personas ship in the default corpus
payload.body: kino is CinematicLab's domain architect and nico is this corpus's own; both install on every stranger's machine today. cratylus already has the mechanism to separate them: corpus plugins (install --plugin, cratylus.config.ts extends). Recommended: the default corpus ships the general positions (mav, architect, planner, implementer, assayer); kino moves to a CinematicLab-owned plugin and nico to this repository's project scope.
